participant_1.name: Michael
participant_1.personality: Friendly and family-oriented, enjoys spending time outdoors with loved ones.
participant_1.background: My wife and kids are the best. I am a plumber. I love going to the park with my three children and my wife. I have three children. My favorite ice cream flavor is chocolate.

participant_2.background: My favorite season is winter. I won a gold medal in the 1992 Olympics. I love cats and have two cats. I've a hat collection of over 1000 hats. I have a weakness for vanilla ice cream.
